description: Following a branch through a hysteresis loop by continuation (ADR 0078 step 3). The bistable state dx/dt = r + x - x^3 has two stable equilibria for |r| < 2/(3 sqrt 3), about 0.385. A study runs it once per round, at points that arrive through its inputs. The continuation block, a map whose rounds are its steps, sends each run the next r and, as its starting value x0, the state the last run settled at; so the state stays on its branch until the branch ends at a fold, then jumps. Sweeping r up to 1 and back down to -1 traces the hysteresis loop: plot settled against r. Each run starts where the last ended: the way to follow equilibria, limit cycles or any state that depends on its history.

bistable.description: A bistable state, dx/dt = r + x - x^3: for |r| < 2/(3 sqrt 3) it has two stable equilibria, outside it one.

blocks.name: cont
equations: # Natural-parameter continuation of the bistable state in r (ADR 0078 step 3)
# Each round runs the model once at the next r, starting from where the last run settled, so it follows the branch it is on
# the point sent to the study: this r, from the last settled state
# up to r_max, then back down to r_min, and so on
turn = (r + dir*dr > r_max + dr/2) + (r + dir*dr < r_min - dr/2)
